decisions.reason: The track spotlight line is core to the modular offer, still has its own page and faces no sign of shortfall in a growing industry, so management sees no trigger for problemistic search.
The ceiling luminaire line fits the established portfolio and keeps a dedicated page, suggesting results near aspiration, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
This recently launched flexible spotlight line sits close to the core and has its own page, and slack lets the firm give it time to reach aspiration levels.
The multi-outlet canopy complements the existing luminaire systems at low cost, so it supports sales of core products and gives no reason for search.
The low-voltage canopy is a cheap system accessory with its own page, and in the absence of shortfall signals management keeps it within the modular range.
The glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which leaves their results more uncertain, but the line is close to the core and slack allows the firm to carry it another year.
